verdict.rationale: Warp's open-source announcement mentions shipping a new settings file explicitly for 'programmatic control over settings and easy portability between devices' (warp-docs-40), which speaks directly to the dotfiles/sync use case, but this is a single passing mention with no documentation of its format, scope, or actual dotfiles-style workflow. Other config-adjacent features (theme OS-sync, session restoration) are separate app-state features, not plain-text portable config. Missing for 10: dedicated docs on the settings file format/location, confirmation it covers full app config (keybindings, workflows, themes), and independent/community corroboration of dotfiles-style syncing across machines.
